recipes.question_supported: Before as_of, does the attributed speaker explicitly assert this exact directed relation in the latest applicable view? Answer yes/no. Silence and similarity are not support.
recipes.question_refuted: Before as_of, does that speaker explicitly deny or withdraw this exact directed relation? Answer yes/no. Silence is not refutation.
recipes.formal_scope: do not reuse explicit-source questions for formal implication; use separate premise-aware recipe

recipes.representation: frozen proposer graph with evidence + one_query
recipes.graph_origin_required: oracle_input or named_proposer; never mix the two quality denominators
recipes.question_supported: Does this directed attributed candidate have an active positive assertion with exact source evidence at or before as_of? Answer yes/no.
recipes.question_refuted: Does this candidate have an active explicit denial or withdrawal with exact source evidence at or before as_of? Answer yes/no.

recipes.representation: positive implication graph + query + candidate support paths
recipes.question: Does this supplied path compose directed positive implication premises from source to target with every premise available by as_of? Answer yes/no.
recipes.candidate_generation: enumerate simple positive implication paths offline; preserve alternatives

recipes.representation: query relation/direction/attribution plus candidate turn text
